baseline.observed: hidden member destination, lost wizard host, unchanged filter URL, silent fallback, and URI decode errors

covered: not-found, forbidden, malformed, and missing-resource routes
canonical legacy Access alias without duplicate activation
Devices and Compute context through reload, Back, Forward, and detail close
page title, current tab, destination focus, deep links, and mobile overflow
live-session wizard draft with no URL, local-storage, or session-storage secrets
H01 account disposal, H02 response ownership, and H03 polling ownership

limitations: Safari, Firefox, physical-device, and specialist screen-reader testing were not performed.
